title: Four-arm polyominoes in Golomb's hierarchy: A complete classification with Lean verification
summary: We classify the polyominoes obtained by adjoining four straight arms to a single square, allowing zero arm lengths, according to their ability to tile rectangles, half-strips, bent strips, quadrants, strips, half-planes, and the plane. We also classify their ability to tile an integer enlargement of themselves. Tiles occupy whole square-grid cells; translations, rotations, and reflections are permitted.
